name: Fox Spirit Contract
source:
"Welcome, Chosen One. My name is Yuki, the Fox Spirit of this shrine."

Welcome to Japan! Up the mountain, there's an abandoned shrine...
What might happen if you go somewhere that no tour guide ever mentioned?
Break the ancient seal, forge an unbreakable bond, and fight the Evil Spirit!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2472340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“欢迎，天选之人。我叫由希，这座神社的狐精。”

欢迎来到日本！山上有一座废弃的神社……
如果你去了一个导游没有提到过的地方，会发生什么？
打破远古封印，结下牢不可破的羁绊，与恶灵战斗！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2472340/]Steam[/url]]
